samples.title: Producer-consumer
samples.summary: Two producers and two consumers share a bounded queue of three jobs.
watch: Producers wait when the queue is full
Consumers wait when it is empty
Each job can be followed from put to get to work

samples.title: Bounded queue backpressure
samples.summary: A fast producer, a slow consumer and a queue that holds only two items.
watch: The producer blocks on put until the consumer makes room
Queue depth sits at its limit while the consumer works

samples.title: Cancellation and shutdown
samples.summary: An immediate queue shutdown discards pending jobs and stops two workers.
watch: Queued jobs are discarded, not processed
Jobs already in progress still finish

samples.title: Plain program, threads only
samples.summary: An ordinary program with no Concurim imports, recorded at the threads level.
watch: Threads and their lifetimes are visible
The queue is not observed, and the viewer says so

samples.title: Plain program, threads and queues
samples.summary: The same program recorded with automatic queue instrumentation.
watch: Compare with the previous example: same code, more visible
Queue contents appear without changing the program

samples.title: Lock contention
samples.summary: Four threads take turns inside one lock-protected critical section.
watch: Only one thread holds the lock at a time
The others wait, and the timeline shows each wait and hold

samples.title: Semaphore limit
samples.summary: A semaphore with two permits lets only two of five threads work at once.
watch: Permits drop to zero while two threads work
Waiting threads resume as permits are released

samples.title: ThreadPoolExecutor
samples.summary: Six tasks run on two pool workers; one task fails.
watch: Tasks wait in the pool's queue, then move to a worker
The failing task is marked failed; the pool keeps going

samples.title: ProcessPoolExecutor
samples.summary: Eight CPU-bound tasks run in three worker processes.
watch: Each worker is a separate process, drawn like a thread
Tasks move from the pool's queue to a worker and back out when done

samples.title: Asyncio task switching
samples.summary: Three tasks share one thread; the event loop switches between them.
watch: Exactly one task runs at a time
A task that awaits is suspended, not blocked

samples.title: asyncio.Queue
samples.summary: One producer task and two consumer tasks share a queue of two items.
watch: A full queue suspends only the producer task
Consumers wait on an empty queue while others run
